interpretation: Same-profile upload impairs the ACK direction more severely than the data direction; mirrored upload is a distinct ablation.
One random realization per cell; not a repeated ranking, causal before/after test, full Cloudflare browser test, aggregation test or sustainability proof.

Application interval rates can exceed link rate because ordered bytes or target confirmations arrive in batches. Router dequeue counters are the physical observation; do not sum parent and child queue backlog.
Download byte count is observed partial delivery during duration-limited request, not completion of the 8GiB body. Echo failure makes the mixed workload fail.
Echo unavailable_after_disconnect slots are not separate network timeouts. Success-only latency percentiles do not replace failed-attempt counts.

Upload only counts target-confirmed bytes. Incomplete runs are lower bounds, never accepted rates. max_delivery_gap records closed positive-confirmation gaps; series and observation tail preserve unfinished stalls.
H2 and TCP mirrored runs exceeded the existing85s runner observation guard. Teardown then reset the probe; those resets are censored, not attributed to product runtime defects.
The ordinary mixed original-profile upload reset at4.996s occurred before deliberate QoS/outage and before runner teardown. Its root cause remains under investigation.
No production code or performance setting changed during these ordinary runs.
